name: VLS Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, VLS Finance Ltd is in the business of a stockbroker[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VLSFL is in the business of investment & Sale /Purchase of Shares /Securities, & Derivatives. It is a Trading and Clearing  Member in the cash segment of NSE and also a Trading Member of NSE in the Future & Options segment. The company also provides consulting and advisory services

pros: Stock is trading at 0.40 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 287 days to 55.8 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.17% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 4.59% of profits over last 3 years
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
